verdict.rationale: Airweave ships its own official agent skills, so agents like Claude Code and Cursor can set up integrations and search data from natural-language requests. Its MCP server lets AI assistants search synced data, and its agentic search mode runs an AI agent over the user's query. Broader operation (managing collections, syncs and connections) through natural language relies on external agents and is only lightly documented. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for full product operation, documented NL coverage of management actions beyond search and setup, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Airweave publishes official skills so that agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other environments can set up integrations and search your data without you having to explain how every time.
An AI agent iteratively searches your data using tool calling.
The Airweave MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol to let AI assistants search your synced data.
